ns2:course.label: Mathematical Statistics
ns2:course.description: Provides a graduate level foundation in fundamental mathematical statistics topics including order statistics, exponential families, sufficiency, Rao-Blackwell theorem, Cramer-Rao lower bound, point estimation, hypothesis testing and interval estimation, likelihood and Bayesian methods, and large-sample asymptotics. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: STAT 410.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: STAT 410.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for PHD:Statistics -UIUC.
